notes.title: [Patch] Someday You’ll Return: Director’s Cut 1.0.1. rev 23040601
notes.notes:
Dear community,

thank you for the feedback we received over the past months. We resolved some of the reported issues, most notably The Beast Within achievement is now fully working.

Here are the changes we've made:

[list]
[*]The Beast Within achievement fixed
[*]Fixed mouse Axis inversion
[*]Fixed karma reset for New Game
[*]Text localization fixes(all languages)
[*]Visual localization fixes(all languages)
[*]Achievements localization fixes(all languages)
[*]Fixed several incorrect collisions
[/list]
